name: my-english-mastery
description: Offline-first, local-only English learning app for Arabic speakers (CEFR A1-C2).

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && next build && node scripts/fix-export-paths.mjs && node scripts/build-sw.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && node scripts/build-apk.mjs assembleDebug
